# DorkForge

### Open, privacy‑first tools for search‑engine reconnaissance and attack‑surface review.

We build free, browser‑based utilities that help defenders find what search engines have indexed by mistake, so it gets fixed before someone else finds it.

## 🔭 What we build

<table>
<tr>
<td width="56%" valign="top">

### 🔎 [DorkForge — Google Dork Builder](https://dorkforge.github.io/)

A mobile‑first builder for advanced search queries, often called *Google dorks*.

- 🧱 Visual builder for `site:`, `intitle:`, `inurl:`, `intext:`, `filetype:`, `before:`/`after:`, ranges and `OR` groups
- 🗂️ **12 GHDB presets** and a **curated library** of 24 tagged dorks
- ⚠️ Built‑in linting that flags broken or unscoped queries
- 🔎 One‑tap search on **Google**, **Bing** and **DuckDuckGo**
- 💾 Local history, saved queries, CSV export and shareable links
- 📱 Installable PWA with light and dark themes

**[Launch app →](https://dorkforge.github.io/)** &nbsp;·&nbsp; **[Source →](https://github.com/DorkForge/DorkForge.github.io)**

## 🧭 Our principles

| | Principle | In practice |
|:---:|---|---|
| 🛡️ | **Defense first** | Every tool is designed to help owners find and fix exposure. Guardrails nudge users to scope queries to domains they're authorized to test. |
| 🔒 | **Private by default** | No accounts, no backend, no analytics. Your data stays in your browser. |
| ⚡ | **Zero friction** | Static sites with no install, no sign‑up and no build step. They open instantly on any device. |
| 🧩 | **Simple & auditable** | Small, dependency‑free code you can read in one sitting and self‑host in one command. |
| 🌍 | **Free & open** | Built in public. Issues, ideas and pull requests are welcome. |

## 🤝 Get involved

- ⭐ **Star** [DorkForge.github.io](https://github.com/DorkForge/DorkForge.github.io) to follow along.
- 💡 **Suggest** a preset, library dork or feature by [opening an issue](https://github.com/DorkForge/DorkForge.github.io/issues/new).
- 🛠️ **Contribute** by reading the [contributing guide](https://github.com/DorkForge/DorkForge.github.io#-contributing) and sending a pull request.
- 🐞 **Report a vulnerability** privately through [Security Advisories](https://github.com/DorkForge/DorkForge.github.io/security/advisories/new).

## ⚖️ Responsible use

> [!IMPORTANT]
> DorkForge tools generate search queries. They don't scan, access or download anything. Only run exposure queries against assets you **own or are explicitly authorized to test**, and treat what you find as something to report and remediate, never to exploit.
